Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer introduced an ambiguous date string (“10/05/1912”) into the search query before verification. This format can be interpreted as either 10 May 1912 (DD/MM) or October 5, 1912 (MM/DD), which led to retrieval of conflicting results (e.g., a source showing October 5). This premature, biased, and locale-ambiguous query seeded the confusion and risked the wrong conclusion instead of starting with neutral searches and confirming via authoritative sources (e.g., ThePeerage) that state 10 May 1912.
